text: I really like this app, in particular I found it because I wanted to have a widget on my home screen. A couple tweaks would be nice: It would be great if I could pay a couple bucks a year to get rid of ads, and the widget could be habit specific instead of trend across all.
author: Lauren Schaefer

text: I like this app cause it shows me an achievement which feels like a reward, but I wish I could edit my habits instead of deleting and rewriting it, so please fix that and I also noticed my streak under each habits has stopped showing, I would love for that to be continued, it motivates me to be consistent. Apart from that, the app is great.
author: Eniola Taiwo
